zuban-source-workspace-evidence.conclusion: The CLI appends the lexical project directory to configured mypy_path. Database workspaces deduplicate lexical normalized root paths, not their canonical physical identities. An absolute /tmp configured path alongside a current directory resolved to /private/tmp can therefore create duplicate workspace/file identities.
